scientific_conclusion: Under the tested fixed architecture and matched data protocol, Set Transformer did not improve mean test MAE over DeepSets and remained behind Static GCN on every seed. Generic learned set attention in this configuration was insufficient to reproduce the advantage observed with explicit periodic kNN graph message passing. Set Transformer has more parameters than both controls, so additional parameter count alone does not explain the Static GCN gain.
limitations: Three seeds; sample SD is descriptive variability, not a confidence interval or significance test.
No claim that all Set Transformers are inferior to GCNs.
No pure causal topology claim: capacity, depth and optimization are not perfectly identical.
Broad leaderboard uses engineered summaries and temporal sequences alongside raw final-snapshot inputs; it is contextual, not a single controlled architecture ablation.
Existing DeepSets headline is Top1000 and remains unchanged; primary Notebook17 controls are explicitly Top1500.
no_retuning_policy: Training and scientific test evaluation are complete. No retuning, model selection, architecture changes, or hyperparameter changes from these test results is permitted. Do not repeat training, inference, or test evaluation for model selection.
